title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body:
Ok, these posts are all the same, down to the title, but always made by someone different. What's up with that? Is it an AI thing? Are you the same guy getting banned and coming back with a new account?

Moderation needs to something about these posts, they are *not* what the sub is about.

You want an opinion, buddy? Go on a sub for screenwriters or filmmakers, there this low-effort spam might at least be tangentially related to 5he scope of the subreddit.
I’ve been seeing this same title on a few other film related subreddits as well, often times without even any body.
